scripts.start:bg: sudo nohup node server.js > /tmp/readit.log 2>&1 & echo $! | sudo tee /tmp/readit.pid > /dev/null && echo 'ReadIt running in background (pid '$(cat /tmp/readit.pid)')'
scripts.stop: sudo kill $(cat /tmp/readit.pid 2>/dev/null) 2>/dev/null && rm -f /tmp/readit.pid && echo 'ReadIt stopped' || echo 'ReadIt is not running'
